title: Detailed planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="planetGrad" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffcc66"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ff9933"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cc6600"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ringGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#88ccff" stop-opacity="0.2"/>
      <stop offset="20%" stop-color="#aaddff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#cceeFF" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#aaddff" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#88ccff" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#88ccff" stop-opacity="0.15"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Back part of rings (behind planet) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="44" ry="11" fill="none" stroke="url(#ringGrad)" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="80 12" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Planet body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="26" fill="url(#planetGrad)"/>

  <!-- Planet surface bands -->
  <path d="M24 42 Q50 36 76 42" fill="none" stroke="#ffdd88" stroke-width="2.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M26 50 Q50 44 74 50" fill="none" stroke="#ffe4a0" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.45"/>
  <path d="M28 58 Q50 52 72 58" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc66" stroke-width="2.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M32 64 Q50 59 68 64" fill="none" stroke="#ffdd88" stroke-width="1.8" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Bright spot / highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="38" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#ffe8b0" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Front part of rings (in front of planet) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="44" ry="11" fill="none" stroke="url(#ringGrad)" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="80 12" opacity="0.9" clip-path="url(#frontHalf)"/>

  <!-- Front ring overlay using path (lower half) -->
  <path d="M6 52 Q6 63 50 63 Q94 63 94 52" fill="none" stroke="#cceeFF" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M6 52 Q6 63 50 63 Q94 63 94 52" fill="none" stroke="#aaddff" stroke-width="3.5" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Ring gap detail -->
  <path d="M10 52 Q10 61 50 61 Q90 61 90 52" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc66" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- Sparkle stars -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="25" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="75" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="72" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.75"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="60" r="1.4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="46" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="18" r="1.2" fill="#cceeFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="78" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="80" r="1.3" fill="#cceeFF" opacity="0.75"/>

  <!-- Tiny sparkle cross stars -->
  <path d="M12 20 L14 20 M13 19 L13 21" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M86 46 L88 46 M87 45 L87 47" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
